# ECN-2026-036 Change notice - Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-SB03

## Reason for change
Field inspection of Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 identified inconsistent retention of the blast wheel liner. Analysis determined the liner fastener preload was below manufacturer recommended values, contributing to accelerated wear and vibration. To standardize maintenance and eliminate ambiguity in technician procedures, the specified bolt torque for the blast wheel liner is being formalized in maintenance documentation and shop procedures.

## Affected items
- EQ-P2-L1-SB03 blast wheel liner fasteners and associated access panels.  
- Maintenance task sequences referenced in SOP-P2-L1-03, SOP-P2-L1-04, SOP-P2-L1-05.

Note: The blast wheel liner bolt torque for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 50 N·m.

## Implementation
- Update maintenance task steps in SOP-P2-L1-03, SOP-P2-L1-04, SOP-P2-L1-05 to state the required torque and verification step.  
- Technicians performing liner service shall apply the specified torque when installing blast wheel liner fasteners and record the value in maintenance logs.  
- Quality to verify correct torque application during the next scheduled liner replacement or inspection event and document verification against the updated SOPs.

## Approvals
- Engineering: authorized to approve revision and update SOP cross-references.  
- Maintenance management: authorized to implement revised procedures and train affected personnel.  
- Quality assurance: authorized to audit compliance and close the ECN when verification is complete.

Related documents: SOP-P2-L1-03, SOP-P2-L1-04, SOP-P2-L1-05

Prepared by: Engineering  
ECN status: Issued for implementation
